CustomField.description: This Form Template's own logo, used in place of the org default logo from the Global Styles tab: an asset name or an https:// link. Optional; leave it blank to use the org default. Banners read it through the Logo formula field.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Optional. An asset name or an https:// link to this form's logo. Leave blank to use the org default logo set on the Form Builder's Global Styles tab.
CustomField.label: Logo Override
